title: lessThanbetter/ssgf: Code for: Confidence-Shielded Evaluator-Conditioned Fusion for Risk-Controlled Infrared-Visible Object Detection
description:
Archival release of the code, frozen manifests, aggregate results, source data, and submission materials for Confidence-Shielded Evaluator-Conditioned Fusion for Risk-Controlled Infrared-Visible Object Detection.

Version v2.4.0 completes the publication-grade figure redesign requested for the Infrared Physics & Technology submission. The main article now contains 11 figures, matching the target reference-paper display-item count, with explicit panels for threshold selection, multiplicity correction, direct Always CDF comparison, label-free controls, external-evaluator portability, calibration failure, risk-return trade-offs, class and thermal boundaries, and deployment cost. Every quantitative figure is backed by a traceable CSV, and every figure PDF passes a 5 pt rendered-text audit. The release includes the final 25-page manuscript, six-page supplement, cover letter, v17 submission package, 11 SVG/PDF figure pairs, reproducibility scripts, and all supporting analyses.

The LLVIP, M3FD, and DroneVehicle images, third-party detector weights, and generated fused-image corpora are not redistributed. Their public sources, fixed manifests, and reproducibility instructions are documented in the repository.
